# Solo

> Solo is a React design system — accessible components, design tokens and charts — styled with Tailwind CSS v4, with first-class Arabic and right-to-left support. Components are imported from `@solo/core` (charts from `@solo/charts`).

Pick components by role, not by look: each entry says what the component is for and what to use instead when it is the wrong fit. Style with logical start/end utilities (`ms-4`, `text-start`), never left/right. See AGENTS.md for the full rules.

- [Full catalog](llms-full.txt): purpose, do / don't, props and hooks for every component
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): how to choose components, RTL rules, tokens, checks

## Action

- Button: Button triggers an action when clicked.
- ButtonGroup: ButtonGroup joins related actions into a single connected control.
- ContextMenu: A right-click context menu that appears at the cursor position.
  - ContextMenuItem: Menu item component for compound mode.
- DropdownMenu: A dropdown menu that displays a list of actionable items in a popup triggered by a button.
  - DropdownMenuCheckboxItem: A checkable menu item (role="menuitemcheckbox") that toggles an independent boolean.
  - DropdownMenuDivider: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu.
  - DropdownMenuItem: Helper component for custom item rendering with consistent styling.
  - DropdownMenuRadioGroup: A single-select group of radio menu items (role="group" of menuitemradio).
  - DropdownMenuRadioItem: A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio").
  - DropdownMenuSubMenu: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items.
- IconButton: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text.
- Link: A styled anchor for inline and standalone text navigation.
  - LinkProvider: Provider that sets the default link component for all Solo link-rendering components in the subtree.
- MoreMenu: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions.
- SegmentedControl: A segmented button group that allows users to make a single selection from a small set of mutually exclusive options.
  - SegmentedControlItem: Individual segment item rendering as a radio button within the segmented control.
- ToggleButton: ToggleButton switches between selected and unselected states to represent a persistent on/off choice.
  - ToggleButtonGroup: Groups toggle buttons for exclusive (single) or multi-select behavior.
- Toolbar: Toolbar is a horizontal bar with start, center, and end areas (they mirror in right-to-left layouts).

## Chat

- Chat: Chat is a family of composable primitives for building AI and human chat experiences.
  - ChatComposer: ChatComposer is the message-entry shell for a chat surface.
  - ChatComposerDrawer: Use ChatComposerDrawer in the ChatComposer drawer slot for supplementary content such as attachments, context chips, or previews.
  - ChatComposerInput: Pass ChatComposerInput to ChatComposer's input slot when the draft needs trigger menus, inline tokens, history recall, dictation insertion, or file intake.
  - ChatComposerTokenElement: Renders a single token chip outside the contentEditable input.
  - ChatLayout: ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces.
  - ChatLayoutScrollButton: Floating scroll-to-bottom button that appears when the user scrolls away from the latest messages.
  - ChatMessage: Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.
  - ChatMessageBubble: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background.
  - ChatMessageList: Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support.
  - ChatMessageMetadata: Place ChatMessageMetadata below a message or in the last ChatMessageBubble metadata slot to show a timestamp, footer content, and optional delivery status.
  - ChatSendButton: Use ChatSendButton as ChatComposer’s send control when the action should switch between sending and stopping.
  - ChatSystemMessage: Use ChatSystemMessage for concise, non-sender content inside a chat transcript.
  - ChatTokenizedText: Use ChatTokenizedText inside a chat message when stored plain text contains serialized token values that should be projected as inline badges or caller-rendered token content.
  - ChatToolCalls: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response.
- ChatDictationButton: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer.

## Container

- Card: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently.
- Carousel: Carousel scrolls a row of items horizontally when they overflow the available width.
- ClickableCard: An interactive card for navigation or action targets.
- Collapsible: Collapsible hides and reveals content behind a trigger button.
  - CollapsibleGroup: Coordinates multiple Collapsible instances so only one (single mode) or any number (multiple mode) can be open at a time.
- SelectableCard: A card that toggles between selected and unselected states with an accent border.

## Content

- Avatar: Avatar represents a person or team with a profile photo, initials, or a default icon.
  - AvatarStatusDot: Size-aware status indicator dot that reads avatar size from context and scales proportionally.
- AvatarGroup: AvatarGroup displays multiple avatars in an overlapping row with an optional overflow indicator.
  - AvatarGroupOverflow: AvatarGroupOverflow appears at the end of an AvatarGroup to summarize people who are not shown individually.
- Blockquote: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color.
- Citation: Citations display inline references to external sources.
- Code: Code marks short inline references such as function names, variables, file paths, and command-line flags.
- CodeBlock: CodeBlock renders syntax-highlighted code with line numbers, a copy button, and optional collapsible sections.
- EmptyState: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data.
- Icon: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts.
- Kbd: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges.
- Markdown: Renders a markdown string as Solo-styled components.
- Text: Text renders styled body text and headings from the theme.
  - Heading: Semantic heading component that renders h1-h6 elements with themed styling, themed sizing via type scale tokens, and line-clamp truncation.
- Thumbnail: Thumbnail displays a compact, square preview of an image attachment.
- Timer: Displays a live duration for active work without scheduling a React render on every tick: the time elapsed since startTime, or — with endTime — the time remaining until a deadline (a countdown).
- Timestamp: Timestamp formats a date or time value into human-readable text.
- Token: Token is a small, inline element for representing discrete pieces of associated data, like tags, categories, or selections.

## Data Visualization

- Chart: Chart lays out one or more mark definitions against shared responsive x and y scales.
- ChartAxis: ChartAxis renders tick labels and optional edge and tick lines from the scales owned by a parent Chart.
- ChartGrid: ChartGrid draws horizontal and vertical guide lines from the scales owned by a parent Chart.
- ChartLegend: ChartLegend pairs series labels with decorative mark-shaped color swatches.
- ChartSwatch: ChartSwatch renders the small decorative mark that pairs a chart series color with its visible label.
- ChartTooltip: ChartTooltip shows grouped values for the chart position nearest the pointer.

## Feedback & Status

- Badge: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance.
- Banner: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section.
- ProgressBar: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task.
- Skeleton: An animated shimmer placeholder that previews the shape of content while it loads.
- Spinner: An animated loading indicator for processes with unknown duration, such as data fetching or form submission.
- StatusDot: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels.

## Form Controls

- Calendar: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid.
- CheckboxInput: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value.
- CheckboxList: CheckboxList shows a small group of checkboxes so users can turn several options on or off at once.
  - CheckboxListItem: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot.
- ComplexSelector: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row.
- DateInput: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover.
- DateRangeInput: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover.
- DateTimeInput: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field.
- Field: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI.
  - FieldLabel: Standalone label component with optional/required indicators and tooltip support.
  - FieldStatus: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls.
- FileInput: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support.
- Indicator: Indicators are the componentized selection visuals shared by CheckboxInput, RadioList, and menu selection rows.
  - CheckboxIndicator: The checkbox visual: a square box with a checkmark or an indeterminate bar.
  - CheckIndicator: The mark on a chosen option: a checkmark by default, and nothing at all when unchosen, so a listbox shows no empty box beside every row.
  - RadioIndicator: The radio visual: a circle with a filled inner dot when selected.
- InputGroup: InputGroup connects an input with prefix/suffix addons in a single visual unit.
  - InputGroupText: A prefix or suffix text element rendered inside InputGroup.
- MultiSelector: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list.
- NumberInput: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls.
- PowerSearch: PowerSearch is a structured filter bar where each token represents a field, operator, and value.
- RadioList: A group of options where only one can be selected at a time.
  - RadioListItem: Individual radio item with label, description, and content slots.
- Selector: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options.
  - SelectorOption: Helper component for custom item rendering inside an Selector renderOption prop.
- Slider: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds.
- Switch: A toggle control for on/off states that take effect immediately.
- TextArea: TextArea is a multi-line text input for collecting longer-form content like comments, descriptions, or messages.
- TextInput: TextInput collects short-form text like names, emails, or search queries.
- TimeInput: TimeInput uses a browser/OS time picker on coarse pointers by default and Solo's typed field on fine pointers.
- Tokenizer: Tokenizer is a multi-select input that lets users search, select, and manage multiple items displayed as removable chips.
- Typeahead: A searchable input for selecting a single item from a large or dynamic dataset.
  - BaseTypeahead: Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown.
  - TypeaheadItem: Default dropdown item renderer for typeahead results.

## Layout

- AppShell: AppShell is the page shell for an application.
- AspectRatio: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes.
- Center: Center aligns content to the middle of its container.
- Divider: A visual separator that divides content into distinct sections.
- FormLayout: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction.
- Grid: A CSS grid layout container for arranging children in rows and columns.
  - GridSpan: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.
- Layout: Layout is a general five-slot primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions within a page or bounded container.
  - LayoutContent: Scrollable main content area.
  - LayoutFooter: Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.
  - LayoutHeader: Top bar for page titles, app bars, and toolbars.
  - LayoutPanel: Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.
  - Section: Section is the correct way to create page regions and group related content on a page.
- Resizable: Hook-based resizable panel system.
  - ResizeHandle: Draggable separator between panels.
- ScrollableArea: Provides a native scroll viewport and a real observed content box.

## Navigation

- Breadcrumbs: Breadcrumbs show a trail of links from the root to the current page.
  - BreadcrumbItem: BreadcrumbItem represents one destination, action, current location, or sibling-menu trigger inside a Breadcrumbs trail.
- MobileNav: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation.
  - MobileNavToggle: Hamburger button that opens/closes the mobile nav drawer.
- NavHeadingMenu: Accessible menu container and items for nav heading popovers.
- NavIcon: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background.
- Outline: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages.
- Pagination: Pagination lets users step through pages of content.
- SideNav: A sidebar navigation component for organizing application pages with sections, nested items, and icons.
  - SideNavCollapseButton: Toggle button for sidenav collapse.
  - SideNavHeading: Product/suite/account heading with smart interaction boundary logic for links and a menu popover.
  - SideNavItem: Navigation item with icon, selected state, optional end content, and nesting support via children.
  - SideNavSection: Section grouping with an optional title, subtitle, and end content.
- Stepper: Steppers display progress through a sequence of logical and numbered steps.
  - Step: Individual step within a Stepper.
- TabList: TabList provides tab-style navigation for organizing content into categorized sections.
  - Tab: Individual tab item that renders as a button or an anchor link, with selected-state styling and optional icons.
  - TabMenu: Overflow menu trigger that opens a dropdown of additional tab options, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text.
- TopNav: TopNav is a horizontal navigation bar for product-level navigation in application headers.
  - TopNavHeading: Product/suite/account heading for the TopNav heading slot.
  - TopNavItem: Navigation link item for use in TopNav startContent: renders as an anchor with hover and selected states.
  - TopNavMegaMenu: Navigation item that displays a full-width mega menu panel on hover.
  - TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard: Standard featured card for the TopNavMegaMenu featured slot.
  - TopNavMegaMenuItem: An individual item inside an TopNavMegaMenu.
  - TopNavMenu: Navigation item that displays a hover-triggered popover menu with rich items containing an icon, title, and optional description.

## Overlay

- AlertDialog: AlertDialog asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before it happens.
- BottomSheet: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport; use BottomSheetSwitcher for multi-step flows.
- BottomSheetSwitcher: Coordinates a multi-step bottom-sheet flow in one shared dialog; set activeSheet to a nested BottomSheet's sheetId to open or switch steps, and to null to close.
- CommandPalette: CommandPalette is a searchable dialog for quick access to commands, navigation, and actions.
  - CommandPaletteEmpty: Empty state display for the results area.
  - CommandPaletteFooter: Footer showing keyboard navigation hints.
  - CommandPaletteGroup: Visual grouping with a heading label.
  - CommandPaletteInput: Search input slot.
  - CommandPaletteItem: A selectable item.
  - CommandPaletteList: Scrollable results container.
- Dialog: Dialog displays a modal overlay that blocks interaction with the page until the user responds.
  - DialogHeader: Use DialogHeader to give a dialog a labelled title area and optional close control.
- HoverCard: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element.
- Lightbox: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution.
- Overlay: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior.
- Popover: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element.
- Toast: Toast shows a brief, non-blocking notification to confirm an action or present temporary information.
- Tooltip: A short text hint that appears on hover or focus, anchored to a trigger element.

## Table & List

- Item: A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across Solo.
- List: A vertical collection of items with consistent spacing, dividers, and optional markers.
  - ListItem: List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.
- MetadataList: MetadataList displays key-value pairs for object attributes like quality, condition, and status, in a structured layout.
  - MetadataListItem: A single labeled metadata value within an MetadataList.
- OverflowList: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width.
- Table: Table displays structured data in rows and columns with consistent dimensionality.
  - TableBody: <tbody> wrapper for children mode.
  - TableCell: <td> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, font size, and divider borders when used inside Table.
  - TableFooter: <tfoot> wrapper for children mode.
  - TableHeader: <thead> wrapper for children mode.
  - TableHeaderCell: <th> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, semibold weight, secondary text color, and divider borders when used inside Table.
  - TableRow: <tr> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply striped, hover, and divider styles when used inside Table.
  - TableSelectionToolbar: Pass both outputs of useTableSelectionState to their matching consumers: selectionConfig to useTableSelection and selectionState to TableSelectionToolbar.
- TreeList: An expandable tree structure for displaying hierarchical data with branch connector lines.

## Utility

- InternationalizationProvider: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides.
- Layer: Layer utilities provide the app-level provider used by overlay systems.
  - LayerProvider: App-level provider for layer systems such as toast viewports and imperative modals.
  - OverlayBoundary: Confines full-screen overlays opened inside it (MobileNav, BottomSheet, BottomSheetSwitcher) to its own on-screen rectangle instead of the whole window, scrim included.
- MediaTheme: Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips.
- SyntaxTheme: Applies syntax highlighting colors to CodeBlock and any code component in the subtree.
- Theme: Wraps a subtree with a specific Solo theme.
- VisuallyHidden: Renders content in the accessibility tree while hiding it visually.
